Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply fungicides (captan or myclobutanil) during wet periods. Prune for air circulation.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_remedy: Spray neem oil or baking soda solution (1 tbsp per gallon). Remove fallen leaves.

Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Remove mummified fruit and cankers. Apply fungicide during wet weather.
Apple___Black_rot.organic_remedy: Prune dead wood. Apply lime sulfur during dormancy.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Remove nearby cedar trees if possible. Apply fungicides in spring.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic_remedy: Apply sulfur-based sprays. Choose resistant varieties.

Apple___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Plant is healthy.

Blueberry___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Plant is healthy.

Cassava___Bacterial_blight.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericides (Copper Oxychloride 3g/L). Prune infected stems with sanitized tools.
Cassava___Bacterial_blight.organic_remedy: Remove and burn infected stems. Plant certified disease-free stem cuttings.

Cassava___Brown_streak.treatment: No chemical cure once infected. Remove and destroy infected plants to prevent whitefly spread.
Cassava___Brown_streak.organic_remedy: Use certified virus-free planting stakes and control whitefly vector using neem extract.

Cassava___Green_mottle.treatment: Rogue out symptomatic cassava plants immediately to prevent plot contamination.
Cassava___Green_mottle.organic_remedy: Use clean planting material and maintain strict field hygiene.

Cassava___Mosaic_disease.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Apply insecticides (Imidacloprid 0.3ml/L) to control whitefly vector.
Cassava___Mosaic_disease.organic_remedy: Plant CMD-resistant varieties and install yellow sticky traps for whitefly control.

Cassava___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Crop is healthy.
Cassava___healthy.organic_remedy: Continue regular weed management and soil health maintenance.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur or fungicides at first sign. Improve air circulation.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.organic_remedy: Spray milk solution (40% milk, 60% water). Remove affected leaves.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Apply fungicides (strobilurins or azoxystrobin). Practice crop rotation.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.organic_remedy: Remove infected debris. Rotate with non-host crops.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Apply fungicides if severe (mancozeb 2g/L). Choose resistant hybrids.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.organic_remedy: Remove infected plants early. Use resistant varieties.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic_remedy: Rotate crops. Till under infected residue.

Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Apply fungicides before bloom (myclobutanil). Remove infected fruit.
Grape___Black_rot.organic_remedy: Prune for air flow. Remove mummified berries.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: No cure. Remove infected vines. Manage trunk wounds.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic_remedy: Protect pruning wounds. Maintain vine vigor.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Apply fungicides (copper hydroxide). Remove fallen leaves.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.organic_remedy: Improve air circulation. Apply copper sprays.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: No cure. Remove infected trees. Control psyllid vector with imidacloprid.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic_remedy: Remove affected trees. Plant certified disease-free nursery stock.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper sprays during dormancy and early season.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.organic_remedy: Prune for air circulation. Avoid overhead irrigation.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericides. Use disease-free seed.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.organic_remedy: Remove infected plants. Avoid wetting leaves.

Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides (chlorothalonil or mancozeb 2.5g/L). Remove infected leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.organic_remedy: Mulch around plants. Rotate crops. Remove infected debris.

Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides immediately (metalaxyl + mancozeb). Destroy infected plants.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_remedy: Remove and destroy infected plants. Apply copper sulfate spray.

Rice___Bacterial_blight.treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride (3g/L) or Streptocycline (1g/10L). Avoid excess nitrogen.
Rice___Bacterial_blight.organic_remedy: Drain field temporarily, spray fresh cow dung extract (20%) or neem oil (5ml/L).

Rice___Blast.treatment: Apply Tricyclazole 75 WP (0.6g/L) or Isoprothiolane at first sign of blast spots.
Rice___Blast.organic_remedy: Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens (10g/L) as foliar spray. Avoid high nitrogen dosage.

Rice___Brown_spot.treatment: Apply Mancozeb (2g/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L). Ensure adequate soil potassium.
Rice___Brown_spot.organic_remedy: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride (10g/kg). Apply vermicompost and bio-potash.

Rice___Tungro.treatment: Apply Imidacloprid (0.3ml/L) or Thiamethoxam to control green leafhopper vector.
Rice___Tungro.organic_remedy: Eradicate alternate weed hosts. Apply neem seed kernel extract (5%) to repel leafhoppers.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.organic_remedy: Spray milk solution (1:9 ratio). Plant resistant varieties.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Apply fungicides (captan or copper). Remove infected leaves.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.organic_remedy: Remove affected leaves. Mulch to prevent soil splashing.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based sprays. Use disease-free transplants.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic_remedy: Remove infected plants. Avoid overhead watering.

Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides (chlorothalonil or mancozeb 2g/L). Remove lower infected leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_remedy: Mulch around plants. Water at base. Rotate crops.

Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides (metalaxyl or cymoxanil). Remove and destroy infected plants.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_remedy: Remove infected plants immediately. Apply copper spray.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Improve air circulation. Apply copper fungicides.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic_remedy: Remove affected leaves. Mulch to prevent soil splash.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Apply miticide (abamectin or fenpyroximate). Increase humidity.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic_remedy: Spray with strong water jet. Apply neem oil or introduce predatory mites.

Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Apply fungicides (azoxystrobin). Remove infected plant debris.
Tomato___Target_Spot.organic_remedy: Improve air circulation. Remove fallen leaves.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Disinfect tools with trisodium phosphate.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic_remedy: Remove infected plants. Use disease-free seed.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: No cure. Control whitefly vector with imidacloprid. Remove infected plants.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic_remedy: Use reflective yellow mulch to repel whiteflies. Remove weed hosts.

Tomato___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Plant is healthy!

Wheat___Aphid.treatment: Apply Dimethoate 30 EC (1.5ml/L) or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL (0.5ml/L) at economic threshold.
Wheat___Aphid.organic_remedy: Spray Neem oil (5ml/L) or release natural predators like ladybird beetles and lacewings.

Wheat___Black_rust.treatment: Apply Propiconazole 25 EC (1ml/L) or Tebuconazole (1ml/L) at first symptom appearance.
Wheat___Black_rust.organic_remedy: Plant resistant wheat cultivars. Apply Trichoderma and remove volunteer grass hosts.

Wheat___Blast.treatment: Spray Tebuconazole + Trifloxystrobin or Mancozeb before and during flowering stages.
Wheat___Blast.organic_remedy: Use certified clean seeds. Practice strict crop rotation and seed treatment with biocontrols.

Wheat___Common_root_rot.treatment: Seed treatment with Carboxin + Thiram (2.5g/kg seed). Ensure well-drained soil.
Wheat___Common_root_rot.organic_remedy: Practice crop rotation with non-cereal crops and enhance soil organic matter with compost.

Wheat___Fusarium_head_blight.treatment: Apply Prothioconazole or Tebuconazole during early flowering stage (anthesis).
Wheat___Fusarium_head_blight.organic_remedy: Avoid overhead irrigation during flowering. Practice deep tillage to bury crop residues.

Wheat___Leaf_blight.treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75 WP (2.5g/L) or Propiconazole 25 EC (1ml/L) at tillering stage.
Wheat___Leaf_blight.organic_remedy: Spray Trichoderma harzianum (5g/L). Maintain proper plant spacing for sunlight penetration.

Wheat___Leaf_rust.treatment: Apply Propiconazole 25 EC (1ml/L) at first detection of orange-brown pustules.
Wheat___Leaf_rust.organic_remedy: Use rust-resistant varieties. Spray fermented buttermilk solution or neem oil (5ml/L).

Wheat___Mite.treatment: Apply Hexythiazox 5.45 EC (1ml/L) or Wettable Sulfur (3g/L) when mite colonies form.
Wheat___Mite.organic_remedy: Spray wettable sulfur or horticultural oil spray. Conserve predatory phytoseiid mites.

Wheat___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply Propiconazole (1ml/L) or Dinocap (1ml/L). Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
Wheat___Powdery_mildew.organic_remedy: Spray potassium bicarbonate or milk solution (1:9 ratio). Prune dense canopy.

Wheat___Septoria.treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil (2g/L) or Pyraclostrobin at flag leaf emergence stage.
Wheat___Septoria.organic_remedy: Remove stubble after harvest. Practice 2-year crop rotation and apply compost tea.

Wheat___Smut.treatment: Seed treatment with Tebuconazole 2 DS (1.5g/kg seed) or Carboxin 75 WP (2.5g/kg seed).
Wheat___Smut.organic_remedy: Solar heat treatment of seeds in summer before sowing. Use certified smut-free seed.

Wheat___Stem_fly.treatment: Apply Chlorpyriphos 20 EC (2ml/L) or soil application of Phorate granules at sowing.
Wheat___Stem_fly.organic_remedy: Early sowing to escape peak infestation. Install yellow sticky traps (10-12 traps/acre).

Wheat___Tan_spot.treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin or Propiconazole fungicides at early leaf spotting.
Wheat___Tan_spot.organic_remedy: Rotate with broadleaf crops like legumes/mustard. Shred and bury straw residues.

Wheat___Yellow_rust.treatment: Apply Propiconazole 25 EC (1ml/L) or Tebuconazole (1ml/L) immediately upon seeing yellow stripes.
Wheat___Yellow_rust.organic_remedy: Plant yellow rust-resistant varieties (e.g. PBW 725, HD 3086). Apply bio-agents early.

Wheat___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Wheat crop is in healthy vigorous condition.
Wheat___healthy.organic_remedy: Continue standard irrigation and balanced nutrient management.
